Barbershops

✦
CLIPPERDESK FOR BARBERSHOPS

Manage barbershop appointments and walk-ins

Manage barber appointments, walk-in queues, staff availability, client preferences and checkout from one workspace.

Start your trial
View pricing

Where it fits: ClipperDesk fits barbershops that need to balance appointments with walk-in demand without treating the queue as a separate spreadsheet or whiteboard.

YOUR WORKING DAY

Keep the day running smoothly
01
The next walk-in cannot break the next booking

Review estimated waits and staff availability before fitting a walk-in around booked appointments.

02
Keep each visit connected

Booked and walk-in visits connect service lines, staff attribution, notes, checkout and receipt history.

03
Respond when the day changes

Identify visits affected by late arrivals, delays, staff absences or unexpected closures.

A CONNECTED SHIFT

From the first booking to the final close.
01

Capture a walk-in with the requested service

02

Review estimated waits and record reasons for queue changes

03

Assign staff without colliding with booked work

04

Start service, record payment and keep the visit history

BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

What to know.
Wait times are estimates based on current work and staff availability.
Marketplace is a separate way for customers to find eligible published businesses. Availability depends on businesses joining each area; new bookings are not guaranteed.

INSIDE CLIPPERDESK

See the workflow before you choose.
A busy Saturday with bookings and walk-ins

Before accepting a walk-in, compare the requested service duration with each eligible barber’s next booking. Record queue changes and explain estimated waits. When service is complete, carry the visit into checkout instead of creating a separate record.

Manage your appointments as an independent stylist

03
A small business still needs explainable history

Receipts, payments, client visits and reports remain linked without deleting corrections.

A CONNECTED SHIFT

From the first booking to the final close.
01

Complete setup and preview the booking page

02

Share the business booking link

03

Work from one calendar and client record

04

Complete checkout and review the day’s totals

ClipperDesk does not provide a marketing marketplace or guarantee new client demand.
Use ClipperDesk in your web browser; there is no native mobile app.

From the first booking to the final close.

Publish services with accurate timing and technician eligibility

02

Keep useful client preferences with the visit

Complete checkout and carry the service into history

Marketplace availability depends on eligible businesses in each area. A listing does not guarantee new bookings.
Memberships, packages, loyalty and automated campaigns are outside the current release.

Manage medspa appointments and client records

Start your trial
View pricing

Where it fits: Consider ClipperDesk for non-clinical scheduling and business administration only. Keep clinical records and regulated care in separately approved systems.

Keep the day running smoothly
01
Practitioner and room capacity must agree

Configured eligibility and physical resources participate in the same availability decision.

02
Intake wording needs a version

Published forms and submitted answers remain tied to the version used for that appointment.

03
Business history still needs traceability

Appointments, tenders, receipts and corrections remain linked without rewriting earlier evidence.

A CONNECTED SHIFT

From the first booking to the final close.
01

Publish only approved non-clinical booking choices

02

Reserve practitioner and room capacity together

03

Collect configured business intake before the visit

04

Close the commercial visit with traceable payment history

BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

What to know.
ClipperDesk is not an electronic medical record system and makes no HIPAA or healthcare-compliance claim.
Clinical charting, prescribing, medical-device workflows and treatment-outcome tracking are not supported.

Manage appointments for your health practice

Organise practitioner schedules, client booking, non-clinical business forms and payment records alongside your clinical systems.

Start your trial
View pricing

Where it fits: ClipperDesk can fit appointment-led allied-health and wellness practices for non-clinical operations where regulated records and care remain in separately approved systems.

YOUR WORKING DAY

Keep the day running smoothly
01
The booking path needs accurate practitioner rules

Published services resolve current eligibility, duration, hours and capacity before a time is offered.

02
Forms need stable wording

Versioned business forms keep the submitted response tied to the wording the client actually saw.

03
Sensitive context needs boundaries

Permissions can narrow access, while clinical and regulated records remain outside ClipperDesk.

A CONNECTED SHIFT

From the first booking to the final close.
01

Configure approved appointment types and practitioners

02

Publish availability through the Business booking page

03

Collect only the configured non-clinical context

04

Record payments received and keep the visit history

BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

What to know.
ClipperDesk does not provide diagnosis, clinical notes, prescriptions, insurance billing or EMR/EHR capability.
Healthcare compliance, retention and consent suitability require independent review before use.

✦
CLIPPERDESK FOR TATTOOING & PIERCING

Manage tattoo and piercing appointments

Manage artist schedules, consultation forms, client preferences, appointment changes and recorded payments in one studio workspace.

Start your trial
View pricing

Where it fits: ClipperDesk fits appointment-led tattoo and piercing studios that need explicit artist eligibility, station capacity, versioned forms and traceable payment history.

YOUR WORKING DAY

Keep the day running smoothly
01
Consultations and sessions need different timing

Each service can carry its real duration, staff eligibility and resource requirements into availability.

02
Consent wording must not drift

Published forms and submitted answers remain frozen to their exact template version.

03
Keep payments linked to the visit

Record payments received elsewhere and review any remaining balance alongside the appointment.

A CONNECTED SHIFT

From the first booking to the final close.
01

Publish consultation and session types with artist eligibility

02

Reserve the artist and configured station capacity

03

Collect the current business form when required

04

Record received payments and issue the final receipt

BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

What to know.
Local licensing, age verification, consent and aftercare obligations require independent legal and operational review.
Portfolio galleries, marketplace discovery and automated marketing are not supported in the current release.
